name: Brawler's Glove

specials.name: Machinegun Punch
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals five hits of Blunt damage to the enemy, which can critically hit, dealing a total of 110% of Brawler's Glove's Scaled Weapon Attack. If any of them hit, the target is also inflicted with Flatfoot until your next turn.

description: A lightweight glove often used to protect a fist fighter's assets.

name: Knuckledusters
description: A sharp pair of brass knuckles.

name: Crash Cymbals

specials.name: Fear Infliction
specials.description: If you are behind your target, inflicts Fear on them until your next turn. (Works even while outside of melee range.)

specials.name: Song Damage
specials.description: When played (via a Song skill): Deals bonus armor-ignoring Sound magic damage equal to 5 + UL to all enemies within 5 Range.

description: A pair of cymbals, which are typically played by smashing them together.

name: Brawler's Glove (Enhanced)

specials.name: Enhanced Stats
specials.description: +3 STR

specials.name: Machinegun Punch
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals five hits of Blunt damage to the enemy, which can critically hit, dealing a total of 110% of Brawler's Glove's Scaled Weapon Attack. If any of them hit, the target is also inflicted with Flatfoot until your next turn.

description: A lightweight glove often used to protect a fist fighter's assets.

name: Boxing Glove

specials.name: Defense Bonus
specials.description: +1-3 DEF

specials.name: Guard Skill
specials.description: Grants skill: Guard. Guard does not deplete the Schwarz Sturm gauge.

description: A type of fighting glove used in one of Kysei's provinces. It gives some defensive options.

name: Tenderizers

specials.name: Vampiric
specials.description: Vampiric (10%)

description: This gauntlet absorbs Focus from the wounds that it makes.

name: Needler

specials.name: Armor Reduction
specials.description: Reduces effectiveness of enemy Armor by 5.

specials.name: Wear Down
specials.description: When an enemy is damaged by weapons that reduce enemy Armor effectiveness, either by basic attacks or by skills using them, a Wear Down status is applied for 3 rounds, or powered up. This status decreases the enemy's Armor by 5 per LV. (Max LV of 20, max duration of 3 rounds).

description: A gauntlet designed to pierce armor.

name: Cougar Claws

specials.name: Cougar Strike
specials.description: Targets 2 location within 1 Range. Location 1 must have an enemy, and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. You attack the target in Location 1 with your Cougar Claws, and then slide to Location 2.

specials.name: Cougar's Roar
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals 110% of Cougar Claws' Scaled Weapon Attack over 8 hits while you teleport around the target. If none of the 8 hits are evaded, you unleash the roar of a Cougar, gaining Cougar's Roar (CEL increases by LV) (LV 10, 5 rounds) and attempt to inflict all enemies in 5 Range with Hesitation (LV 15, 2 rounds).

specials.name: Roar Synergy
specials.description: This item's Power, Hit, and Critical are increased by +5 while you have any Roar-type status effect active.

description: A deadly pair of claws best used by the agile.

name: Spirit Gauntlet

specials.name: Focus Restoration
specials.description: Restores Focus based on damage dealt. (10%)

description: This gauntlet absorbs Focus from the wounds that it makes.

name: Ninja Scroll
description: Concealed within the wrist of these otherwise unassuming gloves is a scroll. Often used by shinobi as a means to transport and use hidden arts.

name: Claw Gauntlet

specials.name: Riprun
specials.description: Targets a 3-7 Range line, which must end in an unoccupied tile. You move along that line, slashing every tile to the left and right of your moving direction, dealing Slash physical damage to all enemies in those tiles equal to 120% Scaled WPN Power. It has a status-based chance to also reduce the Phys. and Mag. Defense of all enemies damaged by 1 + half of Claw Gauntlet's UL, for 3 rounds. The chance is much higher against monsters.

description: These are normal fighter's gauntlets, except they have been affixed with claws, causing them to rend enemies instead of pummel them.

name: Pickpocketers

specials.name: Steal Bonus
specials.description: Increases Steal's success rate by 15%.

specials.name: Pilfer
specials.description: Targets one enemy within 1 Range. Messes with the target's inventory, preventing them from using items for 2 rounds.

description: A pair of gloves that excel at theft.

name: Maned Tonfa

specials.name: Guard Skill
specials.description: Grants Skill: Guard (1+ Momentum, 0FP) - Raise your shield and protect yourself from enemy attacks. Consumes all remaining Momentum, but until your next action, all damage you take is reduced by (Momentum consumed * 10)%.

specials.name: Tonfa Block
specials.description: Increases the LV of Guard statuses applied to you by 5 if you are two-handing this weapon.

specials.name: Tonfa Parry
specials.description: Parry skill. Grants a chance to parry non-spell, non-ranged weapon damage for 25% reduction. Activate Rate: 15% + 50% of Scaled DEF, +10% if the owner of this skill has the Roar status active.

description: A pair of wooden tonfa with a fur-like mane at its head. They are often used by defensive strikers.

name: Burst Claw

specials.name: Fire Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Fire damage equal to 50% of your Fire ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Weapon Charge Consumption
specials.description: Consumes Weapon Charges, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

specials.name: Red Raid
specials.description: Dash forward in a 4 Range line (+1 for every Weapon Charge level). If you encounter an enemy, you grab them and cause an explosion around them, dealing Blunt physical damage to all enemies in a 2 Range circle around them equal to 100% of Burst Claw's SWA, then your Weapon Charge level increases by 1.

description: An explosive set of claws that can cause fire plumes to appear when it strikes.

name: Shadow Wind Claw

specials.name: Elemental ATK Bonus
specials.description: +5 Darkness & Wind ATK

specials.name: Debuff Immunity
specials.description: If you have at least 40 base CEL, gain Debuff Immunity LV1 for 3 rounds.

specials.name: Air Explosion
specials.description: Triggers after the attack hits an enemy. Knocks the target airborne, deals 35 armor-ignoring Wind magic bonus damage to them, and applies an Aero Shift (5) effect to all tiles in 5 Range.

description: This claw-like gauntlet will tear through enemies and shield you in a veil of darkness.

name: Excellion

specials.name: Charge Weapon
specials.description: Grants Skill: Charge Weapon (3 Momentum, 5 FP) - Rev your weapon and fill it with focus, increasing its Charge, to a maximum of level 3. When you hit with a weapon that can consume Weapon Charges, the damage you deal with that attack will increase by 50% per level. (Weapon Charges will expire after 5 rounds.)

specials.name: Weapon Charge Consumption
specials.description: Consumes Weapon Charge, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

specials.name: Elite Engine
specials.description: Charge Weapon FP cost is increased to 8 FP. Attacks do not use up all of your charges, instead the LV is reduced by 1, and the damage bonus is 35% (does not increase with charge amount like normal Excel attacks).

description: The Excel line of weapons were developed in Chaturanga, where the ability to be defensive while increasing offensive capabilities was highly valued. By charging up the weapon, it can explosively spend the focus energy when it strikes an enemy, greatly increasing damage. However, the engine module makes it heavier than other weapons.

name: Bear Claws

specials.name: Stat Bonus
specials.description: +2 STR, +2 VIT

specials.name: Scary Mauling
specials.description: +10% Critical Damage for Claws-type weapons. On Critical Hit (Bear Claws only): Automatically activate the skill 'Bellow' (3 round cooldown). Bellow - Roars loudly, generating a strong fighting will. Deals Sound magic damage equal to 150% Sound ATK to all enemies in Circle (2) range. Also increases the user's STR by LV/5 (min. 3) for 3 rounds.

description: Shaped somewhat like a bear's paw, the claws hidden within will shred anyone caught in them just as effectively.

name: Whulf

specials.name: The Wolf's Claws Set
specials.description: Set: The Wolf's Claws. 2+ - 1) Grants access to the Shooting Star skill. 2) Increases the range of the Kick skill by 5. 3) Kick skill causes you to fly towards your target.

description: A set of gloves with sharp claws extending from them. They are enchanted with the spirit of a great beast of light.

name: Sea Hunter Gauntlet

specials.name: Hunted Infliction
specials.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

description: This gauntlet was born from the sea, and as anyone who lives there knows, anything that lives in the sea is out to get everything else... that lives in the sea.

name: Magical Comet

specials.name: Spelledge
specials.description: This weapon can be used as a casting tool for spells.

specials.name: Unmasking Trail
specials.description: This skill requires a Rank D Invocation. Drops down blue stars on all enemies in the battle, dealing Ice magic damage equal to 100% of Magical Comet's SWA + 150% of your Ice ATK. Enemies who are under transformation effects take 50% extra damage and have those transformations effect(s)'s duration cut by 5 rounds. (This then goes on a 3 round CD.)

description: Leave impacts that will only fade after an eon. Will not help you transform, however.

name: Kusarigami

specials.name: Weight Strike
specials.description: Has a special secondary attack called 'Weight Strike', and grants access to the 'Spin Kusarigami' skill. Weight Strike: 3M, Basic attack that deals Blunt Damage.

specials.name: Spin Kusarigami
specials.description: Spin Kusarigami: 1M, Puts Weight Strike on 1 round CD, but the next time you attack with it and it hits, you pull the target 3 tiles towards you. Afterwards, if they are within 1 Range of you, you automatically apply the Grapple skill to them.

description: The Kusarigami is traditionally seen as a strange weapon. Part kama, part weighed chain, it is a weapon that requires a good deal of skill to use effectively. The origin of the weapon is relatively unknown, but has been found discarded in places such as deserts or canyons, theorized to have been used for its utility, or its surprising ability to be concealed due to its flexible nature.

name: Shredder Replica

specials.name: Divine Weapon
specials.description: Always comes enchanted with Divine Weapon. (+2 Power, +5 Critical, +5 Accuracy, -2 Weight. Weapon durability cannot decrease.)

description: A replica of a deadly pair of gauntlets that rend flesh. It possesses extremely high power.

name: Helrenroka

specials.name: Fire ATK Substitution
specials.description: Replaces your Fire ATK with the target's for 2 Rounds.

specials.name: Guiding Flame
specials.description: Helrenroka's Potential Skill. Ninjutsu. Requires Substitute Fire ATK to be active. Invoke a fiery ninja art, dealing 20 armor-ignoring Fire Kickback damage to you, curing Blind effects you suffer from, and creating a burst of Fire around you that damages all enemies in a 3 Size Circle for Fire magic damage (can critically hit for +25% damage, ignores Reflect, Immunity, and Absorb) equal to 100% of Helrenroka's Scaled Weapon Attack + 100% of the Substitute Fire ATK from its effect. Damaged enemies are inflicted with Glowing LV 10 (3 rounds). 2 round CD. Furinkazan: Gain 1 Fire Mark.

description: A gauntlet said to once belong to a ninja who could summon fire.

name: Giant Slayer

specials.name: Giant Slaying
specials.description: Basic attacks with this weapon deal 15% more damage if the target is a Giant, Enlarged, or has the Mountain skill. Also applies to enemies with a Gigantic torso enchantment at half effectiveness.

specials.name: Demoralize Giants
specials.description: On Defeat Enemy: If enemy was a Giant, Enlarged, had the Mountain skill, or a Gigantic torso enchantment, and this weapon defeated them, all other enemies in the battle of those same categories suffer -5 to all stats (except VIT) for 5 rounds.

description: A sling, made to be swung and fire rocks at enemies. The biggest ones are easiest to hit.

name: Ymir

specials.name: Freezing Knockback
specials.description: If target is not immune to knockback effects; Inflicts knockback (1 tile) in your current direction. If the enemy doesn't move from this effect (due to that tile being invalid/occupied), they take Ice magic damage equal to 150% of your Ice ATK. (Activations of this effect beyond the first in a round will only use 50% instead.)

description: The frosty gauntlets of a frosty giant.

name: Fenri

specials.name: Ice Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Ice damage equal to 50% of your Ice ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: WIL Bonus
specials.description: +3 WIL

specials.name: Freezing Round
specials.description: Grants Skill: Freezing Round (3 Momentum, 10 FP) - Spin your weapon, Fenri, around your body and let it tear into all enemies within 1 Range of you, dealing Ice physical damage equal to 100% of Scaled Weapon Attack to them.

description: A three-sided nunchaku enchanted with strong ice powers. It is said to contain the soul of a legendary wolf that once had dominion over the frozen lands of Lordwain, the snow-covered continent to the north, where Lispool and Hyoya exist. However, this may just be a legend.

name: Cobalt Qrytys

specials.name: Dual Type
specials.description: Also qualifies as a Dagger weapon.

description: This heavy, cold-blue metallic gauntlet hides within it several retractable dagger-like claws.

name: Pinchers

specials.name: Restrain
specials.description: UL% chance of automatically applying Restrain to the target.

description: A set of natural claws that are made for giving your enemies the clamps. Just watch your fingers.

name: Mortissimo

specials.name: Fear Damage
specials.description: Deals 1+UL unresistable Sound Damage if target is Feared.

description: These thin, wired claws make a powerful screech when they hit an enemy just right. Not approved for scratching itches.

name: Hands of the Giant

specials.name: STR Increase
specials.description: Increases STR by UL/2. (Halved if not main weapon.)

specials.name: Knockback
specials.description: Knockbacks 1 tile per 6 UL. (min. 1)

specials.name: Knockdown
specials.description: On Critical Hit: UL% chance to knock down the target.

description: These hands are giant! They belonged to a giant! They will make you as strong as a giant! Most likely. They're quite heavy, however.

name: Deadclaw

specials.name: Grounded Advantage
specials.description: Scaled Weapon Attack and Critical Damage for this weapon are increased by UL/UL% respectively against enemies who are Knocked Down.

description: The downward facing claws on this gauntlet are quite deadly to anyone who may have tripped and can't get away.

name: Buzzing Chakram

specials.name: Range Increase
specials.description: Attack range increases by 1 for every 6 UL.

specials.name: Bouncing Acid
specials.description: Bounces to an enemy within 5 Range and deals UL Acid magic bonus damage to them that ignores armor, then repeats. (Enemies cannot be hit more than once per activation and the original target cannot be the initial bounce target.)

description: This chakram vibrates within your hands and sounds strangely like the buzzing of insect wings...
